content_units: Workshop Flow for 14 May 2026
Remote workshop length:   3h 30m   from   13:00-16:30 UTC   for   9 participants  .

This agenda is optimized for   quarterly planning  ,   choosing 3 product priorities  , and a   short retrospective  , while keeping total presentation time to   35 minutes   and protecting the last   20 minutes   for owners and follow-through.
Detailed Agenda Timeline
Phase   Goal   Key Tasks   Deliverable
13:00-13:10   Kickoff and alignment   Welcome; review goals; confirm decision rules; roles for facilitator/timekeeper/notetaker   Shared understanding of outcomes and process
13:10-13:25   Quarterly context briefing   15-minute presentation on business context, key metrics, customer signals, risks   Common planning baseline
13:25-13:45   Silent input: opportunities and constraints   Individuals add ideas in board/doc; capture bets, dependencies, capacity concerns   Broad input from all 9 participants
13:45-14:10   Cluster and discuss planning themes   Group similar ideas; identify 4-6 major themes; clarify overlaps   Draft planning themes
14:10-14:25   Break   15-minute pause   Team reset
14:25-14:40   Product options briefing   15-minute presentation on candidate initiatives and trade-offs   Clear shortlist for prioritization
14:40-15:10   Prioritization workshop   Score or vote on initiatives using impact vs effort; discuss top contenders; narrow to 3   Ranked product priorities
15:10-15:35   Decision and success criteria   Confirm final 3 priorities; define why each matters; note target outcomes and constraints   Final decision on top 3 priorities
15:35-15:50   Team retrospective   Fast retro: start/stop/continue or mad/sad/glad; capture 3-5 improvement themes   Short retro insights
15:50-16:10   Action items and owners   Convert decisions into actions; assign owner, due date, next checkpoint   Action tracker with owners
16:10-16:30   Buffer and close   Resolve open points; confirm communications; recap decisions and next milestones   Clean close with no loose ends
Facilitation Notes That Fit the Constraints
-   Total presentation time:   30 minutes scheduled, plus 5 minutes of kickoff framing =   35 minutes total  , under the 45-minute cap.
-   Break included:     14:10-14:25  .
-   Final 20 minutes protected:     15:50-16:10   is dedicated to action items and owners.
-   Extra buffer:     16:10-16:30   prevents overruns and helps a cross-time-zone group finish clearly.
Recommended roles:
-   Facilitator:   keeps flow and equal participation
-   Timekeeper:   enforces segment timing
-   Notetaker:   captures decisions, owners, due dates
-   Decision owner:   confirms the final 3 priorities
Suggested working methods:
- Use   silent writing first   to balance Europe/Asia voices.
- Use   dot voting or impact/effort scoring   to avoid long debate.
- For the retrospective, keep it lightweight and action-oriented.
Ready-to-Run Session Plan
Option 1: Balanced decision workshop   Best if you need alignment and commitment without rushing     Low presentation, high participation
Copy agenda
Option 2: More analytical prioritization   Better if the team wants scoring rigor for the 3 priorities     Use impact-effort or RICE-lite
Prioritize
Option 3: Faster-paced format   Best if calendars are tight and input is already pre-collected     More decision time, less discovery
